info.title: HL-MCK Automation Antidetect Browser API
info.description: Local REST API for browser profile management and automation. Runs on the desktop app's own machine (default http://127.0.0.1:4000). Every endpoint here mirrors what the desktop UI itself does — profiles, proxies, scripts and tasks created or modified through this API are the exact same records shown in the app. Swagger UI available at /docs.

Fingerprint.description: Spoofed browser identity applied via engine/fingerprintInit.js before any page script runs.

ProxySettings.description: Proxy embedded directly on the profile (host:port string, no reference to a Proxies pool record).

applyOverrides.description: Per-field toggle for whether each fingerprint override is actually applied at launch.

id.description: Generated by the server; same 'prof-<timestamp><random>' convention whether created via the desktop UI or this API.

locale.description: Must be a real BCP-47 tag (e.g. en-US); invalid/placeholder values are ignored and a random locale is generated instead.

ProfileUpdateRequest.description: Partial update — only provided fields are merged into the existing profile.

server.description: Alternative to host/port/type: a raw 'host:port' or 'scheme://host:port' string.

settings.description: Any raw settings fields, merged in as-is (overlaid over generated/existing settings).

fingerprint.description: Raw fingerprint fields, merged in as-is over the existing fingerprint.
